node.statement: For an arbitrary compact smooth manifold M without boundary, the conjunction of: existence of K and a C^r triangulation f: |K| -> M; the implication that this triangulation is a homeomorphism onto M; the implication that a homeomorphism |K| -> M with M compact forces K to have finitely many vertices; and the implication that finite vertex set forces K to be a finite simplicial complex, entails that M is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex.
